mapper.select: SELECT so.code, so.approve_status, so.order_type, so.warehouse_org_id, so.warehouseorg_name, so.warehouse_id, so.warehouse_name, so.plan_delivery_date, so.pack_date, so.actual_delivery_date, so.create_time, so.create_user_name, so.customer_id, sod.sku_id, sod.sku_no, sod.plan_qty, sod.actual_qty FROM so_outstock so INNER JOIN so_outstock_detail sod ON sod.main_id=so.id AND sod.is_deleted=FALSE WHERE so.is_deleted=FALSE AND so.so_id=#{soId}
